params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P1
Summary: The Studio review page still does nothing on click after #456, so no post can be published. The page's script is refused by the staff gate, and gentells.com is about to launch with posts waiting.

## What happens

#456 (for #455) moved the review page's inline scripts into one same-origin script, `GET /articles/:id/review/page.js?t=`, because nginx allows only same-origin scripts. The page now loads that script as `<script src>`. That request carries no bearer header, the same as the page itself in its iframe. `page.js` is not on the public allowlist in `packages/server/public-routes.mjs`, so the gate answers 401 before the route checks its review token. The page is as dead as before.

Live: `/api/pipeline/articles/x/review/page?t=bad` answers with the route's own "The review link is missing or expired", but `/api/pipeline/articles/x/review/page.js?t=bad` answers with the gate's generic `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`.

#456's tests called the Studio route handler directly and never went through the gate, so they could not see this.

## Fix

Put `page.js` next to `page` and `submit` in the review pattern of `public-routes.mjs`. The route keeps its own check on the review token. Add a test that goes through the real server with no bearer header and loads the script the page names.

Follows #455. Source: Portal mail:52 (the same thread as mail:50).
params.title: Studio review page still dead after #456: the staff gate refuses its script (page.js)
